limitations: Lowering detection is a source scan, not conformance certification.
CSV parser rejects malformed quoted input more strictly than the production parser.
Any supports scalar values only; arbitrary dynamic objects and full generic inference remain incomplete.
Native callbacks, by-value structs and full cross-platform ABI verification remain incomplete.
Unannotated mutually recursive, loop-dependent and heterogeneous return signatures are not inferred.
Expression AST child handles are process-local, not a portable serialized graph.
All advertised members have a lowering, but inventory detection does not certify full production type/error/runtime parity.
Graphics show operations depend on the host browser opener; HTTP listener is synchronous and serves requests sequentially.
External format/network features can require Python packages, installed host tools, credentials or reachable services.
All catalog members have a lowering, but inventory detection does not prove every production overload, error path, and external-service behavior is identical.

External format and network APIs can depend on Python packages, host tools, credentials, and reachable services.
